commit.message:
fix(unicorn2): switch to the complete JIT patch and drop the JNI-side guard

Background:
The same crash reproduces with upstream's official Java binding on master (7c5db941) and
dev (938efd13): calling mem_unmap / ctl_remove_cache from a UC_HOOK_INTR hook dies with
SIGBUS in do_tb_phys_invalidate. The previous patch only made tb_exec_change always
switch; with the official binding the nested call then returns to Java with the thread
still in write mode and the JVM faults on its own interpreter code. unidbg had worked
around that with the JNI guard in unicorn.c. The fix belongs inside unicorn.

Changes:
- patches/0001-apple-jit-state-for-hooks-in-foreign-runtimes.patch replaces the old
  patch; its core code is identical, line for line, to the PR prepared for upstream:
  - tb_exec_change() always applies the requested state instead of trusting the cache
  - restore_jit_state() restores the entry state on every nesting level, not only the
    outermost one
  - nested uc_emu_start() calls save/restore the state as well, including the two
    early-return error paths
- unicorn.c: remove the ENTER_UNICORN guard; compared with before the upgrade, the only
  remaining difference is the removed eb stubs
- README: update the description of the patch
- rebuild the five artifacts with the new patch (fresh clone of the upstream tag plus
  patches/); they still contain only arm/aarch64

Verification:
- macOS arm64 (Zulu 8, JDK 21): AndroidTest, Android64Test, ThreadTest, Utilities32/64,
  SignalTest, Signal64Test, MemoryTrackerTest and KQueue64Test, 18 runs, all pass and
  match the old library's output token by token (only pids differ)
- Linux arm64 / x86_64 (run in containers): 14 runs, all pass, output identical
- upstream dev + this patch: ctest 12/12; the new C regression test gets SIGBUS on
  unpatched dev, gets SIGBUS when running the runtime's own JIT code with only the
  tb_exec_change change, and passes with the complete fix

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

build(unicorn2): build from upstream unicorn 2.1.4 instead of the fork

Background:
The backend was built from the unicorn2 branch of zhkl0228/unicorn, which is based on
2.0.1.post1 and only adds two tb_exec_lock lines. Upstream 2.1.4 only appends to the
enums in its public headers and leaves arm64.h unchanged, so the Java constants and
Java code need no changes.

Required fix on macOS arm64:
- 2.1.x caches the per-thread MAP_JIT write protection and skips
  pthread_jit_write_protect_np() when the cache already matches. HotSpot toggles the
  same state on every JNI transition, so calling uc_mem_unmap or a nested emu_start from
  a hook runs with a stale cache and dies with SIGBUS in do_tb_phys_invalidate; with
  stock 2.1.4 the Android tests crash right at startup
- patches/0001-apple-jit-always-apply-write-protect.patch: tb_exec_change always
  applies the requested state. The code is only compiled on Apple arm64
- unicorn.c: JNI methods that enter unicorn switch the thread back to execute mode
  before returning to Java; HotSpot was observed not to do this itself when a native
  method returns
- A/B: the JNI change alone still crashes; the patch alone crashes on return to Java;
  only both together pass
- remove the armeb/aarch64eb stubs, which nothing references any more

Build:
- build.sh pins upstream tag 2.1.4: clones it when missing, applies patches/, and
  checks that the tree is exactly "upstream + patches" before building; fails early
  when pkg-config is missing (qemu/configure needs it and cmake does not propagate its
  failure, so the build used to die later on unrelated compile errors); only builds
  unicorn_archive; UNICORN_HOME now defaults to ~/git/unicorn-2.1.4
- Dockerfile and Dockerfile.windows clone the upstream tag and apply the patches; the
  mingw toolchain file moved to cmake/mingw-w64.cmake upstream
- every build still sets UNICORN_ARCH="arm;aarch64"; the five artifacts contain only the
  arm/aarch64 guest targets and no symbols of any other architecture

Pre-existing issues fixed along the way:
- when osx_64 is cross-compiled on an arm64 host, unicorn's host detection and
  qemu/configure run the compiler without -arch and pick the AArch64 TCG backend: the
  shipped library's tcg_target_call_iarg_regs was {0..7} instead of the x86_64
  {7,6,2,1,8,9}, so it could not work on Intel Macs. Add cc-x86_64.sh as the x86_64
  compiler
- EPEL 7 is no longer usable (metalink retired, the archive sits behind a bot
  challenge); the Linux image now uses Kitware's cmake 3.22.6 binary instead of EPEL

Verification:
- macOS arm64 (Zulu 8, JDK 21) and Linux arm64/x86_64 (release artifacts run in
  containers): AndroidTest, Android64Test, ThreadTest, Utilities32/64, SignalTest,
  Signal64Test and KQueue64Test all pass; compared token by token with the old library
  the output differs only in pid/tid/container IP
- performance: Utilities32 34.6s -> 12.3s on macOS and 57.3s -> 14.1s on Linux arm64;
  Utilities64 is 2~3.7x faster
- the Linux .so is built with CentOS 7's gcc 4.8.5 and still requires only glibc 2.17
- Windows: only the build and the import/export tables were checked; osx_64: static
  checks only (no Rosetta on the build machine)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
fix: load bundled Unicorn2 library before system library

Consolidate build scripts across all backends

- dynarmic: Add --clean flag, auto-build static libs, Docker cache-bust
  via DYNARMIC_COMMIT ARG, rename ARM64 build dir to build_arm64
- unicorn2: Replace 5 scripts with unified build.sh, add Docker
  cache-bust via UNICORN_COMMIT ARG, rename ARM64 build dir to
  build_arm64, rebuild macOS native libraries
- kvm: Merge docker_build.sh and linux_build.sh into unified build.sh
- hypervisor: Rename osx_build.sh to build.sh with improved formatting
- Update all backend README.md with build documentation

Refactor Unicorn backends: extract vector reg validation, convert anonymous classes to lambdas

- Extract checkVectorRegId() to AbstractBackend, eliminating 4 duplicate validation blocks
- Convert hook anonymous inner classes to lambda expressions in both UnicornBackend and Unicorn2Backend
- Replace UnHook anonymous classes with method references (unHook::unhook)
- Remove unnecessary type casts for unambiguous lambda targets (WriteHook, EventMemHook, InterruptHook)
- DebugHook kept as anonymous class (2 abstract methods, not a functional interface)
- Remove unused Arm64Const/ArmConst imports

Refactor backends: extract common BreakPointImpl, enableVFP, decodeSWI into AbstractBackend and remove redundant pom versions

Add Windows cross-compilation and dynarmic linux_arm64 Docker build support

- Add Dockerfile.windows for unicorn2 (Ubuntu 22.04 + mingw-w64, using official mingw-w64.cmake toolchain)
- Add Dockerfile.windows for dynarmic (Ubuntu 24.04 + mingw-w64, GCC 13 for C++20)
- Update docker_build.sh for both backends to support linux_arm64/linux_64/windows_64/all
- Refactor dynarmic Dockerfile for multi-arch: aarch64 uses devtoolset-10 with altarch SCL repos,
  x86_64 uses devtoolset-11, auto-installs CMake 3.22 when system cmake is too old
- Make Zydis linking conditional in dynarmic CMakeLists.txt (x86_64-only library)
- Fix mincore() platform compatibility: use char* on macOS, unsigned char* on Linux
- Rebuild osx_64 native libraries for both backends

Made-with: Cursor

Add Docker cross-compilation for unicorn2 backend and rebuild native libraries

- Add Dockerfile (CentOS 7, supports both amd64/arm64 via --platform)
- Add CMakeLists.txt for JNI glue layer with unicorn static library linking
- Add docker_build.sh supporting linux_64 and linux_arm64 targets
- Rebuild libunicorn.so (linux_64, linux_arm64) and libunicorn.dylib (osx_arm64)
- Add memory diagnostics to TTEncrypt test

Made-with: Cursor

Fix unicorn2 JNI: use-after-free, memory leaks, thread safety, and code quality

- Fix nativeDestroy use-after-free: close engine before freeing struct
- Add hook lifecycle tracking (linked list) to clean up all hooks on destroy
- Fix removeBreakPoint: add key existence check before kh_del
- Fix reg_read: initialize longVal to 0 to avoid garbage in upper bytes
- Fix JNI Attach/Detach: use GetEnv to check before detaching caller thread
- Add default branch to registerHook switch to prevent resource leaks
- Fix hook_count_cb parameter type: struct uc_struct* -> uc_engine*
- Move linker stub functions from header to .c to avoid multiple definitions
- Refactor cb_debugger: extract shouldBreak helper for readability
- Remove redundant double cast in context_alloc
- Unify indentation to 2-space style throughout

Made-with: Cursor

Add mem_allocated_size and mem_resident_size JNI functions to all backends

Expose memory statistics through the Backend interface:
- mem_allocated_size: total virtual memory registered via mem_map
- mem_resident_size: actual physical memory resident (via mincore on macOS/Linux)
- Implemented for hypervisor, dynarmic, kvm, and unicorn2 backends
